title: TEXT PLATES FIT THE WORDS ON THEM
why: His order of 2026-10-09 is to rewrite the raid text in the voice of a shooter HUD, and the words he rewrites himself have to sit properly on their plates. The game sized every plate, badge and box on the original wording while it drew his, so a longer line ran off the end of its plate and a shorter one sat in an empty box. Measuring now uses the same words that are drawn, his edits and the built in ones included, so every plate fits the line it carries.
now: Text plates and boxes are sized on the words actually drawn, so reworded lines fit their plates.
